notices.title: 🚨 Mandatory Notice: Electrical Load & False Ceiling Guidelines
notices.content: All buyers undertaking interior planning must submit false ceiling drawings and electrical load requirements to the site engineering office before beginning work. Standard connected load per 3BHK unit is 8kW. Enhancements require prior approval.

notices.title: 📌 Q4 Construction Milestone: Tower A & B RCC Slabs Completed
notices.content: We are thrilled to announce that the structural RCC casting for all 18 floors of Tower A and Tower B has been completed on schedule. External plastering and window frame installations are now underway.

notices.title: 🏢 Notice for Tower A Residents: Otis High-Speed Lift Installation
notices.content: Otis elevator shafts have reached Tower A 14th floor. Mechanical hoist testing will run between 9 AM and 5 PM this week. Passenger lift handover is planned for February 2027.

notices.title: 🔑 Unit A-1204: Woodwork & Tile Selection Schedule
notices.content: Dear Mr. Rahul Sharma, your 3BHK unit is ready for tile selection and kitchen modular layout sign-off. Please visit the site experience center this Saturday between 11 AM - 2 PM.

notices.title: 💧 Rainwater Harvesting & Dual Plumbing System Testing
notices.content: The campus eco-grid with 6 percolation wells and the dual water recycling setup has achieved zero leakage certification from Green Building Council auditors.

notices.title: ⚡ Tower B: Main Electrical Riser Cable Pulling Begins
notices.content: Armoured copper riser cables are being installed in Tower B shafts from basement substation to 18th floor distribution panels.

notices.title: 📋 Unit B-0301: Plumbing Inspection Passed
notices.content: Hydrostatic pressure testing for hot/cold CPVC water lines in both master and guest bathrooms for unit B-0301 has successfully passed inspection at 10 Bar pressure for 24 hours.

notices.title: 🏊 Clubhouse Podium & Swimming Pool Deck Concreting
notices.content: Podium slab waterproofing and Olympic-size infinity pool concrete pouring has commenced. Completion of the clubhouse structure is slated for March 2027.

notices.title: 📑 Demand Note & 7th Slab Payment Milestone Notice
notices.content: Buyers whose unit payment plan is linked to the 7th structural floor completion slab are requested to verify demand notes dispatched to their registered email IDs.

notices.title: 🏗️ Tower C: 8th Floor Slab Casting Scheduled
notices.content: Concrete pumps will be deployed tonight starting 10:00 PM for the continuous casting of Tower C eighth-floor floor plate.

notices.title: 🌿 Landscaping & Miyawaki Forest Planting Drive
notices.content: Phase-1 central lawn leveling completed. Over 400 indigenous tree saplings are being planted along the perimeter jogging track.

notices.title: 🚗 Basement 2 Car Park Epoxy Flooring Application
notices.content: Vehicular movement in Basement-2 will be restricted as high-durability epoxy coating and parking bay numbering is being applied.

notices.title: 🔔 Tower A: Fire Sprinkler & Smoke Detection Network
notices.content: Floor 1 to 12 smoke detectors and deluge valves have been connected to the central fire command console. Testing commences next Tuesday.

notices.title: 🚪 Unit A-1204: Main Teakwood Door Frame Fixed
notices.content: Main entrance premium teakwood frame has been secured with heavy-duty anchors and anti-termite treatment completed.

notices.title: ☀️ Rooftop Solar Photovoltaic Grid Installation
notices.content: Solar panels of 120kW combined capacity will power all common area lighting and backup systems, reducing maintenance overheads by 35%.
